name: Polypad
description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: commitment window, bonding curve, graduation to Uniswap V4.

PolydashFactory.note: Current factory used by polypad.family. Creator fee cap 500 bps (5%).

PolydashLaunch.note: Launch implementation for the current factory (launchImplementation()).

PolydashHook.note: Uniswap V4 hook for the current factory (hook()). Constructor: poolManager, factory.

PolydashCommitVault.note: Deployed with the legacy factory as constructor argument; not referenced by the current factory.

PolydashToken.note: Deployed per launch by the factory (no single address).

PolydashFactory.note: Earlier factory. Creator fee cap 200 bps (2%). Existing launches stay live and are still listed.
PolydashFactory.abiFile: same ABI as the current contract of the same name

PolydashLaunch.note: Implementation contract; each launch is an EIP-1167 clone of this address.
PolydashLaunch.abiFile: same ABI as the current contract of the same name
